newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION - Jones playing "minder" to big Jonah.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - Jones playing "minder" to big Jonah.

text.p: AUCKLAND, Nov 19 - All Black rugby coach John Hart is hoping that having veteran flanker Michael Jones playing minder will be a good influence on colossal winger Jonah Lomu, NZPA reported on Tuesday.
Hart, who is coach of the New Zealand Barbarians team leaving today for a two-match tour of Great Britain, said Jones' presence motivated Lomu.
"It is important for Jonah that he arrives in the United Kingdom sharp. He's had a frustrating season and Michael can be a very good influence in assisting that process," Hart said.
"I've always thought you train better with someone else."
Lomu and Jones have been training partners since early last year.
"When you see the guy training and work so hard, you just want to do the same," Lomu said of Jones.
Jones attended both of Lomu's weddings this year.
Hart intends using both first five-eighths in his squad, the incumbent Andrew Mehrtens and Auckland's Carlos Spencer, in the game against England on November 30.
While Mehrtens had been regarded as undisputed number one for a couple of seasons, Spencer's dazzling display in the National Provincial Championship has shot him to the top.
"I intend to use the substitution rules," Hart said.
"So we've got to have them on the bench and we need good players like Carlos Spencer as we also have three wings."
Hart has been delighted with the way Joeli Vidiri slotted into the side at the team's training yesterday.

"It is an exciting opportunity for Joeli and clearly we want to see how we can develop him on this tour," said Hart of the former Fijian international, widely regarded as one of the best wingers in the world at present.

The New Zealand Barbarians leave this afternoon and could be joined by flanker Josh Kronfeld and hooker Norm Hewitt who will be playing in Europe over the next few weeks for the French and British Barbarians.
